title: Finite products of abelian categories with enough injectives
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set and let $(\mathcal A_i)_{i\in I}$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], each with enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Their product category $\prod_{i\in I}\mathcal A_i$ is abelian, has enough injectives, and an object $(J_i)_i$ is injective exactly when every $J_i$ is injective in $\mathcal A_i$. For any family of objects $(A_i)_i$, a componentwise choice of injective resolutions $A_i\to J_i^\bullet$ is an injective resolution of $(A_i)_i$ in the product category.
